title: t1d_simulator: Multiphysics Digital Twin Engine for Encapsulated Beta-Cell & Hypoimmune Organoid Transplants
description: An open-source, calibrated multiphysics digital twin simulating oxygen reaction-diffusion, Krogh diffusion limits, biomaterial foreign body response (FBR), Instant Blood-Mediated Inflammatory Reaction (IBMIR 0-48h), Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), and Graph Neural Network (GNN) surface screening for Type 1 Diabetes cell therapy optimization.
